                "qload" | "qunload" | "qstore" | "qexchm" => {
                    let (_, cells) = self
                        .regions
                        .get(&a[0])
                        .cloned()
                        .ok_or_else(|| Error("§4.6: unknown region".into()))?;
                    let value = if op == "qload" {
                        let w = self.produce(&i.lhs[0], cells.first().map_or(0, Vec::len));
                        out.push(Node::Alloc(w.clone()));
                        w
                    } else {
                        self.bundle(&a[2])?
                    };
                    for (index, cell) in cells.iter().enumerate() {
                        let c = with(&self.address(&a[1], index)?, &predicate);
                        for (x, y) in cell.iter().zip(&value) {
                            out.push(match op {
                                "qexchm" => Node::Swap(c.clone(), x.clone(), y.clone()),
                                "qstore" => Node::Flip(with(&[(y.clone(), true)], &c), x.clone()),
                                _ => Node::Flip(with(&[(x.clone(), true)], &c), y.clone()),
                            });
                        }
                    }
                    if op == "qunload" {
                        out.push(Node::Free(value));
                    }
                }
                "oracle_call" | "action_call" | "adj" | "ctl" => {
                    let call = normalize_call(i)?;
                    let mut c = predicate.clone();
                    if let Some(w) = &call.control {
                        c = with(&[(self.scalar(w)?, true)], &c);
                    }
                    let ca = &call.instruction.operands;
                    let callee = self.object.declaration(ca[0].trim_start_matches('@'))?;
                    if call.instruction.op == "oracle_call" {
                        let inputs = list(&ca[2])?
                            .iter()
                            .map(|n| self.bundle(n))
                            .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                            .concat();
                        let mut outputs = self.bundle(&ca[3])?;
                        outputs.extend(self.bundle(&ca[4])?);
                        let mut memory = Vec::new();
                        for n in list(&ca[5])? {
                            let (_, cells) = self.regions.get(&n).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
                                Error("§4.7: oracle mem operand is not a live region".into())
                            })?;
                            memory.extend(cells.into_iter().flatten());
                        }
                        out.push(Node::Opaque {
                            key: format!(
                                "oracle:{:?}",
                                (
                                    &callee.name,
                                    self.classical(&ca[1])?,
                                    list(&ca[6])?
                                        .iter()
                                        .map(|n| self.classical(n))
                                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?
                                )
                            ),
                            controls: c,
                            inputs: [inputs, memory].concat(),
                            outputs,
                            assign: false,
                        });
                    } else if callee.kind == "perm_action"
                        && self.object.functions.contains_key(&callee.name)
                    {
                        // Inline the exact permutation (the call graph is acyclic).
                        let f = &self.object.functions[&callee.name];
                        let mut child = Compiler {
                            trace: None,
                            live_borrowed: BTreeSet::new(),
                            object: self.object,
                            bundles: BTreeMap::new(),
                            regions: BTreeMap::new(),
                            borrowed: BTreeSet::new(),
                            classical: BTreeMap::new(),
                            generation: self.generation,
                        };
                        for (group, actuals) in [(0, list(&ca[1])?), (1, list(&ca[2])?)] {
                            for (p, n) in f.params[group].iter().zip(actuals) {
                                child.bundles.insert(p.name.clone(), self.bundle(&n)?);
                            }
                        }
                        for (p, n) in f.params[2].iter().zip(list(&ca[3])?) {
                            let r =
                                self.regions.get(&n).cloned().ok_or_else(|| {
                                    Error("§4.7: region operand is not live".into())
                                })?;
                            child.regions.insert(p.name.clone(), r);
                        }
                        for (p, n) in f.params[3].iter().zip(list(&ca[4])?) {
                            child.classical.insert(p.name.clone(), self.classical(&n)?);
                        }
                        let mut body = Vec::new();
                        child.compile_function(f, &c, &mut body)?;
                        self.generation = child.generation;
                        self.borrowed.extend(child.borrowed);
                        if call.adjoint {
                            body = body.iter().rev().map(Node::adjoint).collect();
                        }
                        out.extend(body);
                    } else {
                        let mut touched: Vec<String> = c.iter().map(|(w, _)| w.clone()).collect();
                        for group in [1, 2] {
                            for n in list(&ca[group])? {
                                touched.extend(self.bundle(&n)?);
                            }
                        }
                        for n in list(&ca[3])? {
                            let (_, cells) = self.regions.get(&n).ok_or_else(|| {
                                Error("§4.7: action mem operand is not a live region".into())
                            })?;
                            touched.extend(cells.iter().flatten().cloned());
                        }
                        out.push(Node::Other(touched));
                    }
                }
                "qinplace" => {
                    let x = self.bundle(&a[3])?;
                    out.push(Node::Opaque {
                        key: format!("qinplace:{:?}", (&a[0], &a[1], self.classical(&a[2])?)),
                        controls: predicate.clone(),
                        inputs: x.clone(),
                        outputs: x,
                        assign: true,
                    });
                }
                _ if gate(op) => {
                    let (controls, targets, diagonal, other) = gate_operands(i)?;
                    let mut c = predicate.clone();
                    for control in &controls {
                        c = with(&[(self.scalar(control)?, true)], &c);
                    }
                    let targets = targets
                        .iter()
                        .map(|t| self.scalar(t))
                        .collect::<Result<Vec<_>>>()?;
                    if diagonal || other {
                        let (key, inverse) = match op {
                            "s" => ("s".into(), "sdg".into()),
                            "sdg" => ("sdg".into(), "s".into()),
                            "t" => ("t".into(), "tdg".into()),
                            "tdg" => ("tdg".into(), "t".into()),
                            "rx" | "ry" | "rz" => {
                                if let Ok(angle) = a[0].parse::<f64>() {
                                    (
                                        format!("{op}:{}", angle.to_bits()),
                                        format!("{op}:{}", (-angle).to_bits()),
                                    )
                                } else {
                                    let angle = self.classical(&a[0])?;
                                    (format!("{op}:{angle}"), format!("inverse:{op}:{angle}"))
                                }
                            }
                            _ => (op.into(), op.into()),
                        };
                        out.push(Node::Quantum {
                            key,
                            inverse,
                            controls: c,
                            targets,
                            diagonal,
                        });
                    } else if op == "swap" {
                        out.push(Node::Swap(c, targets[0].clone(), targets[1].clone()));
                    } else {
                        out.push(Node::Flip(c, targets[0].clone()));
                    }
                }
                _ => {
                    return err(
                        "§4.8",
                        format!("unknown action opcode {op} in borrow analysis"),
                    )
                }
            }
            if let (Some(mut snapshot), Some(trace)) = (snapshot, &mut self.trace) {
                snapshot.nodes = out[start..].to_vec();
                trace.entry(i.line).or_default().push(snapshot);
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}

/// Extensional identity of one black-box output bit at its symbolic inputs.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
struct Application {
    key: String,
    bit: usize,
    inputs: Vec<Poly>,
}
/// Symbolic evaluation state of one frame.
#[derive(Clone)]
struct Evaluation<'a> {
    opaque_seen: bool,
    obligations: BTreeMap<Poly, String>,
    vars: BTreeMap<String, u32>,
    state: BTreeMap<String, Poly>,
    opaque: BTreeMap<Application, u32>,
    applications: BTreeMap<u32, Application>,
    borrowed: &'a BTreeSet<u32>,
}
impl Evaluation<'_> {
    fn symbol(&mut self, app: Application) -> Result<Poly> {
        self.opaque_seen = true;
        if app.inputs.iter().any(|p| p.mentions(self.borrowed)) {
            return err("§5.6", "composed black-box input depends on borrowed wires; needs a §12 borrow_frames claim");
        }
        let next = self.vars.len() as u32 + self.opaque.len() as u32;
        let id = *self.opaque.entry(app.clone()).or_insert(next);
        self.applications.insert(id, app);
        Ok(Poly::var(id))
    }
    /// Simultaneous substitution, recursively through applications. Inserted
    /// replacement polynomials are already in the destination coordinate system.
    fn substitute(&mut self, p: &Poly, map: &BTreeMap<u32, Poly>) -> Result<Poly> {
        let mut out = Poly::zero();
        for m in &p.0 {
            let mut term = Poly::one();
            for v in m {
                let value = if let Some(value) = map.get(v) {
                    value.clone()
                } else if let Some(mut app) = self.applications.get(v).cloned() {
                    app.inputs = app
                        .inputs
                        .iter()
                        .map(|p| self.substitute(p, map))
                        .collect::<Result<_>>()?;
                    self.symbol(app)?
                } else {
                    Poly::var(*v)
                };
                term = term.and(&value);
            }
            out = out.xor(&term);
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
    fn compose(
        &mut self,
        first: &BTreeMap<String, Poly>,
        then: &BTreeMap<String, Poly>,
    ) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, Poly>> {
        let sub = first
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(w, p)| self.vars.get(w).map(|v| (*v, p.clone())))
            .collect();
        then.iter()
            .map(|(w, p)| Ok((w.clone(), self.substitute(p, &sub)?)))
            .collect()
    }
    fn transport_obligations(
        &mut self,
        obligations: &BTreeMap<Poly, String>,
        map: &BTreeMap<String, Poly>,
    ) -> Result<BTreeMap<Poly, String>> {
        let sub = map
            .iter()
            .filter_map(|(w, p)| self.vars.get(w).map(|v| (*v, p.clone())))
            .collect();
        obligations
            .iter()
            .map(|(p, message)| Ok((self.substitute(p, &sub)?, message.clone())))
            .collect()
    }
    fn var(&mut self, w: &str) -> Poly {
        if let Some(p) = self.state.get(w) {
            return p.clone();
        }
        let id = self.vars.len() as u32 + self.opaque.len() as u32;
        let id = self.vars.entry(w.to_string()).or_insert(id);
        let p = Poly::var(*id);
        self.state.insert(w.to_string(), p.clone());
        p
    }
    fn condition(&mut self, controls: &[(String, bool)]) -> Poly {
        let mut c = Poly::one();
        for (w, polarity) in controls {
            let v = self.var(w);
            c = c.and(&if *polarity { v } else { v.xor(&Poly::one()) });
        }
        c
    }
    fn apply(&mut self, node: &Node) -> Result<()> {
        match node {
            Node::Flip(controls, t) => {
                let c = self.condition(controls);
                let v = self.var(t).xor(&c);
                self.state.insert(t.clone(), v);
            }
            Node::Swap(controls, a, b) => {
                let c = self.condition(controls);
                let (x, y) = (self.var(a), self.var(b));
                let d = c.and(&x.xor(&y));
                self.state.insert(a.clone(), x.xor(&d));
                self.state.insert(b.clone(), y.xor(&d));
            }
            Node::Borrow(wires) => {
                // Every borrowing starts an independent unknown system. A loop
                // summary may reuse its symbolic name only AFTER its return has
                // proved identity and independence on the full entry domain.
                for w in wires {
                    let p = Poly::var(self.vars[w]);
                    self.state.insert(w.clone(), p);
                }
            }
            Node::Return(wires) => {
                let returned: BTreeSet<_> = wires.iter().map(|w| self.vars[w]).collect();
                for w in wires {
                    let difference = self.var(w).xor(&Poly::var(self.vars[w]));
                    self.obligations.insert(
                        difference,
                        format!("qreturn does not restore borrowed wire {w}"),
                    );
                }
                for (w, p) in &self.state {
                    if !wires.contains(w) {
                        // Boolean derivative: zero iff this output is independent
                        // of this lifetime's fresh borrowed entry bit.
                        for v in &returned {
                            let derivative = Poly(
                                p.0.iter()
                                    .filter(|m| m.contains(v))
                                    .map(|m| m.iter().filter(|x| *x != v).copied().collect())
                                    .collect(),
                            );
                            self.obligations.insert(
                                derivative,
                                format!("qreturn output {w} depends on borrowed entry values"),
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }
                for w in wires {
                    self.state.remove(w);
                }
            }
            Node::Alloc(wires) => {
                for w in wires {
                    self.state.insert(w.clone(), Poly::zero());
                }
            }
            Node::Free(wires) => {
                for w in wires {
                    let value = self.var(w);
                    self.obligations.insert(
                        value,
                        "a wire released inside a borrow frame is not clean".into(),
                    );
                    self.state.remove(w);
                }
            }
            Node::Opaque {
                key,
                controls,
                inputs,
                outputs,
                assign,
            } => {
                self.opaque_seen = true;
                let ins: Vec<Poly> = inputs.iter().map(|w| self.var(w)).collect();
                let c = self.condition(controls);
                if ins
                    .iter()
                    .chain(std::iter::once(&c))
                    .any(|p| p.mentions(self.borrowed))
                {
                    return err(
                        "§5.6",
                        format!("{key}: a black-box call whose inputs depend on borrowed wires inside a borrow frame needs a §12 borrow_frames claim"),
                    );
                }
                let olds: Vec<Poly> = outputs.iter().map(|w| self.var(w)).collect();
                for (j, (w, old)) in outputs.iter().zip(olds).enumerate() {
                    // A canonical symbol for output j of the black box at these inputs.
                    let symbol = self.symbol(Application {
                        key: key.clone(),
                        bit: j,
                        inputs: ins.clone(),
                    })?;
                    let value = if *assign { symbol } else { old.xor(&symbol) };
                    // Under the control condition c: c*value + (1+c)*old.
                    let merged = c.and(&value).xor(&c.xor(&Poly::one()).and(&old));
                    self.state.insert(w.clone(), merged);
                }
            }
            Node::Repeat(n, body) => {
                if *n == 0 {
                    return Ok(());
                }
                // Summarize both the carried map AND every internal lifetime
                // obligation. Doubling transports obligations to each reachable
                // entry; known-clean surrounding state is substituted only after
                // composition, without assuming all iterations share that state.
                let mut wires = BTreeSet::new();
                for b in body {
                    b.wires(&mut wires);
                }
                let entry: BTreeMap<u32, Poly> = wires
                    .iter()
                    .map(|w| {
                        let p = self.var(w);
                        (self.vars[w], p)
                    })
                    .collect();
                let identity: BTreeMap<String, Poly> = wires
                    .iter()
                    .map(|w| (w.clone(), Poly::var(self.vars[w])))
                    .collect();
                let saved = std::mem::replace(&mut self.state, identity);
                let saved_obligations = std::mem::take(&mut self.obligations);
                for b in body {
                    self.apply(b)?;
                }
                let body_map = std::mem::replace(&mut self.state, saved);
                let mut power: BTreeMap<String, Poly> = body_map;
                let mut power_obligations =
                    std::mem::replace(&mut self.obligations, saved_obligations);
                let mut result_obligations = BTreeMap::new();
                let mut result: BTreeMap<String, Poly> = wires
                    .iter()
                    .map(|w| (w.clone(), Poly::var(self.vars[w])))
                    .collect();
                let mut k = *n;
                while k > 0 {
                    if k & 1 == 1 {
                        result_obligations
                            .extend(self.transport_obligations(&power_obligations, &result)?);
                        result = self.compose(&result, &power)?;
                    }
                    k >>= 1;
                    if k > 0 {
                        power_obligations
                            .extend(self.transport_obligations(&power_obligations, &power)?);
                        power = self.compose(&power, &power)?;
                    }
                }
                for (p, message) in result_obligations {
                    let value = self.substitute(&p, &entry)?;
                    self.obligations.insert(value, message);
                }
                for (w, p) in result {
                    let value = self.substitute(&p, &entry)?;
                    self.state.insert(w, value);
                }
            }
            Node::Other(_) | Node::Quantum { .. } => {
                return err("§5.6", "non-permutation operation inside a frame")
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
fn check_permutation_touches(nodes: &[Node], borrowed: &BTreeSet<String>) -> Result<()> {
    for node in nodes {
        if let Node::Repeat(n, body) = node {
            if *n != 0 {
                check_permutation_touches(body, borrowed)?;
            }
        } else if !node.permutation() && touches(node, borrowed) {
            return err(
                "§5.6",
                "borrowed wire touched by a non-permutation instruction",
            );
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn touches(node: &Node, borrowed: &BTreeSet<String>) -> bool {
    let mut w = BTreeSet::new();
    node.wires(&mut w);
    !w.is_disjoint(borrowed)
}
fn flat_flips(frame: &[Node]) -> Option<Vec<(Vec<String>, String)>> {
    frame
        .iter()
        .map(|n| match n {
            Node::Flip(c, t) if c.iter().all(|(_, p)| *p) => {
                Some((c.iter().map(|(w, _)| w.clone()).collect(), t.clone()))
            }
            _ => None,
        })
        .collect()
}
fn instruction(controls: &[String], target: &str) -> Instruction {
    let (op, operands) = match controls.len() {
        0 => ("x".to_string(), vec![target.to_string()]),
        1 => ("cx".into(), vec![controls[0].clone(), target.into()]),
        2 => (
            "ccx".into(),
            vec![controls[0].clone(), controls[1].clone(), target.into()],
        ),
        _ => (
            "mcx".into(),
            vec![format!("({})", controls.join(", ")), target.into()],
        ),
    };
    Instruction {
        lhs: Vec::new(),
        op,
        operands,
        bodies: Vec::new(),
        line: 0,
    }
}
/// The structural route: the frame is V; W; V^-1; W (§5.6 (i)-(iv)).
fn translation_lemma(frame: &[Node], borrowed: &BTreeSet<String>) -> bool {
    let Some(flips) = flat_flips(frame) else {
        return false;
    };
    if !flips.len().is_multiple_of(2) {
        return false;
    }
    let half = flips.len() / 2;
    for vlen in 1..half {
        let (v, w) = (&flips[..vlen], &flips[vlen..half]);
        let v_inverse: Vec<_> = v.iter().rev().cloned().collect();
        if flips[half..half + vlen] == v_inverse[..] && flips[half + vlen..] == *w {
            let x = v.iter().flat_map(|(c, _)| c.iter().cloned()).collect();
            let to = |s: &[(Vec<String>, String)]| {
                s.iter().map(|(c, t)| instruction(c, t)).collect::<Vec<_>>()
            };
            if validate_translation_lemma(&to(v), &to(w), &x, borrowed).is_ok() {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    false
}
/// The exact route: P_F = P' ⊗ I_B on the frame's full domain.
enum FrameFailure {
    Invalid(Error),
    NeedsClaim(Error),
}
impl From<Error> for FrameFailure {
    fn from(e: Error) -> Self {
        Self::Invalid(e)
    }
}
/// A saved inverse is usable only until any operand is touched. Keeping the
/// old polynomial also keeps correlations; an unknown result never invents zero.
#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
struct InverseFact {
    gate: Node,
    before: BTreeMap<String, Poly>,
}
struct Facts<'a> {
    e: Evaluation<'a>,
    borrowed: &'a BTreeSet<String>,
    inverses: Vec<InverseFact>,
    frame: Vec<Node>,
    unresolved: Option<Error>,
}
impl Facts<'_> {
    fn unknown(&mut self, w: &str) {
        let id = (self.e.vars.len() + self.e.opaque.len()) as u32;
        self.e.vars.insert(format!("unknown_{id}"), id);
        self.e.state.insert(w.into(), Poly::var(id));
    }
    fn forget_inverses(&mut self, touched: &BTreeSet<String>) {
        self.inverses.retain(|fact| {
            let mut operands = BTreeSet::new();
            fact.gate.wires(&mut operands);
            operands.is_disjoint(touched)
        });
    }
    fn flush(&mut self) -> std::result::Result<(), FrameFailure> {
        if self.frame.iter().any(|n| touches(n, self.borrowed)) {
            // The cropped translation lemma remains a sufficient gate-frame
            // proof. Lifetime equations are mandatory even on this route.
            let first = self
                .frame
                .iter()
                .position(|n| touches(n, self.borrowed))
                .unwrap();
            let last = self
                .frame
                .iter()
                .rposition(|n| touches(n, self.borrowed))
                .unwrap();
            let structural = translation_lemma(&self.frame[first..=last], self.borrowed);
            let result = check_factorisation(&self.e, self.borrowed, structural);
            match result {
                Err(FrameFailure::NeedsClaim(e)) => {
                    self.unresolved.get_or_insert(e);
                }
                other => other?,
            }
        }
        self.e.obligations.clear();
        self.frame.clear();
        Ok(())
    }
    fn sequence(&mut self, nodes: &[Node]) -> std::result::Result<(), FrameFailure> {
        for node in nodes {
            if let Node::Repeat(n, body) = node {
                if *n == 0 {
                    continue; // §4.6: no dynamic gate, touch, frame or lifetime.
                }
                if !node.permutation() {
                    self.repeat(*n, body)?;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            let mut touched = BTreeSet::new();
            node.wires(&mut touched);
            if !node.permutation() {
                self.flush()?;
                if let Node::Quantum {
                    controls,
                    targets,
                    diagonal,
                    ..
                } = node
                {
                    // A known-false predicate disables the gate. Controls are
                    // read-only even when they enable a genuinely quantum gate.
                    if self.e.condition(controls) == Poly::zero() {
                        continue;
                    }
                    if let Some(index) =
                        self.inverses.iter().position(|f| f.gate.adjoint() == *node)
                    {
                        let saved = self.inverses.remove(index);
                        self.forget_inverses(&touched);
                        self.e.state.extend(saved.before);
                        continue;
                    }
                    self.forget_inverses(&touched);
                    if !diagonal {
                        let before = targets.iter().map(|w| (w.clone(), self.e.var(w))).collect();
                        for w in targets {
                            self.unknown(w);
                        }
                        self.inverses.push(InverseFact {
                            gate: node.clone(),
                            before,
                        });
                    }
                } else {
                    self.forget_inverses(&touched);
                    for w in touched {
                        self.unknown(&w);
                    }
                }
            } else {
                self.forget_inverses(&touched);
                if let Err(error) = self.e.apply(node) {
                    if self.e.opaque_seen {
                        self.unresolved.get_or_insert(error);
                    } else {
                        return Err(FrameFailure::Invalid(error));
                    }
                }
                self.frame.push(node.clone());
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn repeat(&mut self, n: u64, body: &[Node]) -> std::result::Result<(), FrameFailure> {
        let mut seen = Vec::new();
        let mut iteration = 0;
        while iteration < n {
            let snapshot = (
                self.e.state.clone(),
                self.e.obligations.clone(),
                self.inverses.clone(),
                self.frame.clone(),
            );
            if let Some((previous, _)) = seen.iter().find(|(_, state)| *state == snapshot) {
                let period = iteration - previous;
                let skip = (n - iteration) / period * period;
                if skip != 0 {
                    iteration += skip;
                    continue;
                }
            }
            // Exact finite traversal is the default. Beyond this work threshold,
            // prove an inductive lattice invariant rather than sampling visits.
            if n - iteration > 1024 && seen.len() >= 1024 {
                return self.invariant(body);
            }
            seen.push((iteration, snapshot));
            self.sequence(body)?;
            iteration += 1;
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    fn invariant(&mut self, body: &[Node]) -> std::result::Result<(), FrameFailure> {
        // Join equal expressions unchanged; disagreement becomes an independent
        // top variable. Every pass removes at least one precise wire fact, or
        // establishes closure. No bound is replaced by a finite sample.
        self.inverses.clear();
        let mut tops: BTreeMap<String, Poly> = BTreeMap::new();
        loop {
            let entry = self.e.state.clone();
            let obligations = self.e.obligations.clone();
            let frame = self.frame.clone();
            self.sequence(body)?;
            self.inverses.clear();
            let mut joined = entry.clone();
            let wires: BTreeSet<_> = entry.keys().chain(self.e.state.keys()).cloned().collect();
            for w in &wires {
                if entry.get(w) != self.e.state.get(w) {
                    let top = if let Some(p) = tops.get(w) {
                        p.clone()
                    } else {
                        self.unknown(w);
                        let p = self.e.state[w].clone();
                        tops.insert(w.clone(), p.clone());
                        p
                    };
                    joined.insert(w.clone(), top);
                }
            }
            if joined == entry && obligations == self.e.obligations && frame == self.frame {
                self.e.state = joined;
                // This state contains every remaining reachable loop entry and
                // exit; body/return proofs above hold for all of them.
                return Ok(());
            }
            self.e.state = joined;
        }
    }
}
fn check_factorisation(
    e: &Evaluation<'_>,
    borrowed: &BTreeSet<String>,
    structural: bool,
) -> std::result::Result<(), FrameFailure> {
    let failure = |error| {
        if e.opaque_seen {
            FrameFailure::NeedsClaim(error)
        } else {
            FrameFailure::Invalid(error)
        }
    };
    for (p, message) in &e.obligations {
        if *p != Poly::zero() {
            return Err(failure(Error(format!("§5.6: {message}"))));
        }
    }
    if structural {
        return Ok(());
    }
    for (w, p) in &e.state {
        match e.vars.get(w) {
            Some(v) if borrowed.contains(w) => {
                if *p != Poly::var(*v) {
                    return Err(failure(Error(format!(
                        "§5.6: borrow frame does not restore borrowed wire {w}"
                    ))));
                }
            }
            _ if p.mentions(e.borrowed) => {
                return Err(failure(Error(format!(
                    "§5.6: borrow frame output {w} depends on borrowed entry values"
                ))));
            }
            _ => {}
        }
    }
    Ok(())
}

impl Object {
    fn borrow_compiler<'a>(&'a self, f: &Function) -> Result<Compiler<'a>> {
        let mut compiler = Compiler {
            trace: None,
            live_borrowed: BTreeSet::new(),
            object: self,
            bundles: BTreeMap::new(),
            regions: BTreeMap::new(),
            borrowed: BTreeSet::new(),
            classical: f
                .params
                .iter()
                .flatten()
                .filter(|p| !matches!(p.ty, Type::Wire(_) | Type::Region(_, _)))
                .map(|p| (p.name.clone(), format!("{}:{}", f.name, p.name)))
                .collect(),
            generation: 0,
        };
        for p in f.params.iter().flatten() {
            match p.ty {
                Type::Wire(width) => {
                    compiler.produce(&p.name, width as usize);
                }
                Type::Region(a, w) => {
                    let cells = crate::oracle::power_of_two(a as u128)
                        .and_then(|n| usize::try_from(n).ok())
                        .ok_or_else(|| {
                            Error("host limit: region exceeds host address space".into())
                        })?;
                    let all = (0..cells).map(|_| compiler.fresh(w as usize)).collect();
                    compiler.regions.insert(p.name.clone(), (a, all));
                }
                _ => {}
            }
        }
        Ok(compiler)
    }
    /// Check a named source frame against the complete compiled circuit,
    /// including inherited predicates, loop structure and physical wire names.
    pub(crate) fn check_translation_frame(
        &self,
        f: &Function,
        endpoints: [&Instruction; 2],
        v: &[&Instruction],
        w: &[&Instruction],
        x: &BTreeSet<String>,
        b: &BTreeSet<String>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        fn locate<'a>(
            seq: &[&'a Instruction],
            first: &Instruction,
            last: &Instruction,
        ) -> Option<(Vec<&'a Instruction>, usize, usize)> {
            if let (Some(a), Some(b)) = (
                seq.iter().position(|i| std::ptr::eq(*i, first)),
                seq.iter().position(|i| std::ptr::eq(*i, last)),
            ) {
                return Some((seq.to_vec(), a, b));
            }
            seq.iter()
                .flat_map(|i| &i.bodies)
                .find_map(|body| locate(&body.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>(), first, last))
        }
        let root: Vec<_> = f.blocks.iter().flat_map(|b| &b.instructions).collect();
        let (seq, start, end) = locate(&root, endpoints[0], endpoints[1]).ok_or_else(|| {
            Error("§5.6/§12.1: frame endpoints do not delimit one contiguous source circuit".into())
        })?;
        if start > end {
            return err("§5.6/§12.1", "reversed frame endpoints");
        }
        let leading: Vec<_> = v.iter().chain(w).copied().collect();
        if leading.len() > end - start + 1
            || leading
                .iter()
                .zip(&seq[start..])
                .any(|(a, b)| !std::ptr::eq(*a, *b))
        {
            return err(
                "§5.6/§12.1",
                "V and W must name every leading instruction of the frame in order",
            );
        }
        let mut compiler = self.borrow_compiler(f)?;
        compiler.trace = Some(BTreeMap::new());
        compiler.compile_function(f, &[], &mut Vec::new())?;
        let trace = compiler
            .trace
            .ok_or_else(|| Error("§5.6: missing structural trace".into()))?;
        let entries = trace
            .get(&endpoints[0].line)
            .ok_or_else(|| Error("§5.6: frame has no compiled context".into()))?;
        for (context, entry) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
            let resolve = |names: &BTreeSet<String>| -> Result<BTreeSet<String>> {
                let mut out = BTreeSet::new();
                for name in names {
                    let (base, index) = match name.split_once('[') {
                        Some((base, index)) => (
                            base,
                            Some(crate::object::host_count(
                                index.trim_end_matches(']'),
                                "wire index",
                            )? as usize),
                        ),
                        None => (name.as_str(), None),
                    };
                    let wires = entry
                        .bundles
                        .get(base)
                        .ok_or_else(|| Error(format!("§5.6: unknown witness wire {name}")))?;
                    if let Some(i) = index {
                        out.insert(
                            wires
                                .get(i)
                                .ok_or_else(|| {
                                    Error("§5.6: witness wire index out of range".into())
                                })?
                                .clone(),
                        );
                    } else {
                        out.extend(wires.iter().cloned());
                    }
                }
                Ok(out)
            };
            let (x, b) = (resolve(x)?, resolve(b)?);
            if !b.is_subset(&entry.borrowed) || b.is_empty() {
                return err("§5.6/§12.1", "B must identify actual live borrowed wires");
            }
            let get = |i: &Instruction| -> Result<&[Node]> {
                trace
                    .get(&i.line)
                    .and_then(|t| t.get(context))
                    .map(|t| t.nodes.as_slice())
                    .ok_or_else(|| {
                        Error("§5.6: inconsistent structural invocation contexts".into())
                    })
            };
            let collect = |points: &[&Instruction]| -> Result<Vec<Node>> {
                let mut nodes = Vec::new();
                for i in points {
                    nodes.extend_from_slice(get(i)?);
                }
                Ok(nodes)
            };
            let vn = collect(v)?;
            let wn = collect(w)?;
            let frame_points = &seq[start..=end];
            let frame = collect(frame_points)?;
            let expected: Vec<_> = vn
                .iter()
                .cloned()
                .chain(wn.iter().cloned())
                .chain(vn.iter().rev().map(Node::adjoint))
                .chain(wn.iter().cloned())
                .collect();
            if frame != expected {
                return err("§5.6/§12.1", "named frame is not V; W; exact reverse V; W");
            }
            fn flips(nodes: &[Node], out: &mut Vec<Instruction>) -> Result<()> {
                for node in nodes {
                    match node {
                        Node::Flip(c, t) => out.push(instruction(
                            &c.iter().map(|(w, _)| w.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                            t,
                        )),
                        Node::Repeat(_, body) => flips(body, out)?,
                        _ => {
                            return err(
                                "§5.6/§12.1",
                                "translation frame contains a non-X-family operation",
                            )
                        }
                    }
                }
                Ok(())
            }
            let (mut vf, mut wf) = (Vec::new(), Vec::new());
            flips(&vn, &mut vf)?;
            flips(&wn, &mut wf)?;
            validate_translation_lemma(&vf, &wf, &x, &b)?;
            let mut touched = BTreeSet::new();
            for node in &frame {
                node.wires(&mut touched);
            }
            if !touched.intersection(&entry.borrowed).all(|w| b.contains(w)) {
                return err(
                    "§5.6/§12.1",
                    "witness omits borrowed wires touched by the frame",
                );
            }
            // First/last borrowed touches delimit the maximal permutation run;
            // lifetime changes and non-permutation operations are boundaries.
            let boundary = |nodes: &[Node]| {
                nodes
                    .iter()
                    .any(|n| !n.permutation() || matches!(n, Node::Borrow(_) | Node::Return(_)))
            };
            if !frame.first().is_some_and(|n| touches(n, &b))
                || !frame.last().is_some_and(|n| touches(n, &b))
            {
                return err("§5.6/§12.1", "frame endpoints must touch B");
            }
            for adjacent in [
                seq[..start].iter().rev().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
                seq[end + 1..].iter().collect(),
            ] {
                for i in adjacent {
                    let nodes = get(i)?;
                    if boundary(nodes) {
                        break;
                    }
                    if nodes.iter().any(|n| touches(n, &b)) {
                        return err("§5.6/§12.1", "named frame omits an adjacent borrowed touch");
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    /// The §5.6 gate-boundary premise is structural, not an exhaustive tuple
    /// obligation. Check it independently for public certificate verification,
    /// which can also be called on an Object assembled through public fields.
    pub(crate) fn check_borrow_frame_structure(&self, f: &Function) -> Result<()> {
        let mut compiler = self.borrow_compiler(f)?;
        let mut nodes = Vec::new();
        compiler.compile_function(f, &[], &mut nodes)?;
        check_permutation_touches(&nodes, &compiler.borrowed)
    }
    pub(crate) fn validate_borrow_frames(&self, f: &Function) -> Result<()> {
        fn has_borrow(seq: &[Instruction]) -> bool {
            seq.iter()
                .any(|i| i.op == "qborrow" || i.bodies.iter().any(|b| has_borrow(b)))
        }
        if !f.blocks.iter().any(|b| has_borrow(&b.instructions)) {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut compiler = self.borrow_compiler(f)?;
        let mut nodes = Vec::new();
        compiler.compile_function(f, &[], &mut nodes)?;
        let borrowed = compiler.borrowed;
        check_permutation_touches(&nodes, &borrowed)?;
        match self.decide_frames(&nodes, &borrowed) {
            Ok(()) => Ok(()),
            // The library route of §5.6: verified certificate borrow_frames claims.
            Err(FrameFailure::NeedsClaim(_)) if self.borrow_frames_certified(f)? => Ok(()),
            Err(FrameFailure::Invalid(e) | FrameFailure::NeedsClaim(e)) => Err(e),
        }
    }
    fn decide_frames(
        &self,
        nodes: &[Node],
        borrowed: &BTreeSet<String>,
    ) -> std::result::Result<(), FrameFailure> {
        check_permutation_touches(nodes, borrowed)?;
        let mut wires = BTreeSet::new();
        for node in nodes {
            node.wires(&mut wires);
        }
        let vars: BTreeMap<String, u32> = wires
            .into_iter()
            .enumerate()
            .map(|(i, w)| (w, i as u32))
            .collect();
        let borrowed_vars = vars
            .iter()
            .filter(|(w, _)| borrowed.contains(*w))
            .map(|(_, v)| *v)
            .collect();
        let e = Evaluation {
            opaque_seen: false,
            obligations: BTreeMap::new(),
            state: vars
                .iter()
                .map(|(w, v)| (w.clone(), Poly::var(*v)))
                .collect(),
            vars,
            opaque: BTreeMap::new(),
            applications: BTreeMap::new(),
            borrowed: &borrowed_vars,
        };
        let mut facts = Facts {
            e,
            borrowed,
            inverses: Vec::new(),
            frame: Vec::new(),
            unresolved: None,
        };
        facts.sequence(nodes)?;
        facts.flush()?;
        match facts.unresolved {
            Some(e) => Err(FrameFailure::NeedsClaim(e)),
            None => Ok(()),
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn unresolved_earlier_frame_cannot_hide_a_definite_later_nonpermutation() {
        let o = Object::parse(include_str!("../tests/fixtures/inc8.bisa")).unwrap();
        let b = "b".to_string();
        let nodes = [
            Node::Borrow(vec![b.clone()]),
            Node::Opaque {
                key: "unknown".into(),
                controls: vec![],
                inputs: vec![b.clone()],
                outputs: vec!["t".into()],
                assign: false,
            },
            Node::Return(vec![b.clone()]),
            Node::Other(vec![b.clone()]),
        ];
        assert!(matches!(
            o.decide_frames(&nodes, &BTreeSet::from([b])),
            Err(FrameFailure::Invalid(_))
        ));
    }
}

use crate::{
    err,
    object::list,
    validation::{gate, gate_operands, normalize_call},
    Error, Function, Instruction, Object, Result, Type,
};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};
/// Complete §5.5 invocation identity; lists retain their operand boundaries.
#[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
struct Invocation {
    callee: String,
    token: String,
    ins: Vec<String>,
    target: String,
    fault: String,
    mem: Vec<String>,
    args: Vec<String>,
}
impl Invocation {
    fn from_row(row: &Instruction) -> Result<Self> {
        let o = &row.operands;
        Ok(Self {
            callee: o[0].clone(),
            token: o[1].clone(),
            ins: list(&o[2])?,
            target: o[3].clone(),
            fault: o[4].clone(),
            mem: list(&o[5])?,
            args: list(&o[6])?,
        })
    }
}
impl Object {
    pub(crate) fn interface_targets(
        &self,
        name: &str,
        active: &mut BTreeSet<String>,
    ) -> Result<BTreeSet<(String, u64)>> {
        if !active.insert(name.into()) {
            return err("§5.1", "recursive region graph");
        }
        let f = self.declaration(name)?;
        let mut out = BTreeSet::new();
        let add = |out: &mut BTreeSet<(String, u64)>, operand: &str| -> Result<()> {
            let (base, index) = if let Some((base, index)) = operand.split_once('[') {
                (
                    base,
                    Some(crate::object::host_count(
                        index.trim_end_matches(']'),
                        "wire index",
                    )?),
                )
            } else {
                (operand, None)
            };
            if let Some(p) = f
                .params
                .iter()
                .flatten()
                .find(|p| p.name == base && matches!(p.ty, Type::Wire(_)))
            {
                if let Some(index) = index {
                    out.insert((base.into(), index));
                } else {
                    for bit in 0..p.ty.width(self.ptr_width)? {
                        out.insert((base.into(), bit));
                    }
                }
            }
            Ok(())
        };
        fn flattened<'a>(seq: &'a [Instruction], out: &mut Vec<&'a Instruction>) {
            for i in seq {
                out.push(i);
                for body in &i.bodies {
                    flattened(body, out);
                }
            }
        }
        let mut instructions = Vec::new();
        for b in &f.blocks {
            flattened(&b.instructions, &mut instructions);
        }
        for i in instructions {
            if gate(&i.op) {
                for target in gate_operands(i)?.1 {
                    add(&mut out, &target)?;
                }
            } else {
                match i.op.as_str() {
                    "qxor" => add(&mut out, &i.operands[1])?,
                    "qexch" => {
                        for target in &i.operands {
                            add(&mut out, target)?;
                        }
                    }
                    "qinplace" => add(&mut out, &i.operands[3])?,
                    "qexchm" => add(&mut out, &i.operands[2])?,
                    "oracle_call" | "action_call" | "adj" | "ctl" => {
                        let call = normalize_call(i)?;
                        let a = &call.instruction.operands;
                        if call.instruction.op == "oracle_call" {
                            add(&mut out, &a[3])?;
                            add(&mut out, &a[4])?;
                        } else {
                            let callee = a[0].trim_start_matches('@');
                            let declaration = self.declaration(callee)?;
                            let actuals = [list(&a[1])?, list(&a[2])?];
                            let targets = self.interface_targets(callee, active)?;
                            for (param, index) in targets {
                                for (group, actual) in actuals.iter().enumerate() {
                                    if let Some(position) = declaration.params[group]
                                        .iter()
                                        .position(|p| p.name == param)
                                    {
                                        add(&mut out, &format!("{}[{index}]", actual[position]))?;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    _ => {}
                }
            }
        }
        active.remove(name);
        Ok(out)
    }
    pub(crate) fn validate_inherited_targets(
        &self,
        call: &Instruction,
        context: &[String],
        types: &BTreeMap<String, Type>,
    ) -> Result<()> {
        if context.is_empty() || call.op != "action_call" {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let a = &call.operands;
        let name = a[0].trim_start_matches('@');
        let f = self.declaration(name)?;
        let actuals = [list(&a[1])?, list(&a[2])?];
        let targets = self.interface_targets(name, &mut BTreeSet::new())?;
        for (param, index) in targets {
            for (group, actual) in actuals.iter().enumerate() {
                if let Some(position) = f.params[group].iter().position(|p| p.name == param) {
                    let actual = &actual[position];
                    if !matches!(types.get(actual), Some(Type::Wire(_) | Type::Qreg(_))) {
                        return err(
                            "§3.3",
                            "controlled region operand must be a wire bundle or qreg",
                        );
                    }
                    if context.contains(&format!("{actual}[{index}]")) {
                        return err(
                            "§3.3",
                            format!("inherited control targets callee wire {param}[{index}]"),
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    /// §5.5 matched cleanup: each `lift.oracle_uncall` pairs with one
    /// outstanding `lift.oracle_call` of identical operands (callee, token,
    /// ins, tgt, fr, mem, args) on EVERY incoming path, with no intervening row
    /// writing its ins or possibly writing a supplied cell. XOR deliveries commute
    /// on outputs only; they still invalidate any invocation reading an output.
    /// Non-delivery writes to tgt/fr also invalidate the invocation.
    /// A forward dataflow over the row CFG: the outstanding multiset meets by
    /// pointwise minimum, address constants (from lift.addr) by agreement.
    pub(crate) fn validate_matched_oracle_calls(&self, f: &Function) -> Result<()> {
        if !f.instructions().any(|i| i.op == "lift.oracle_uncall") {
            return Ok(());
        }
        let mut rows = Vec::new();
        let mut labels = BTreeMap::new();
        for block in &f.blocks {
            labels.insert(block.name.clone(), rows.len());
            rows.extend(&block.instructions);
        }
        let label = |s: &str| -> Result<usize> {
            labels
                .get(s.trim_start_matches('^'))
                .copied()
                .ok_or_else(|| Error(format!("§3.6: unknown label {s}")))
        };
        let mut successors = Vec::new();
        for (k, row) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
            successors.push(match row.op.as_str() {
                "qjump" => vec![label(&row.operands[0])?],
                "qbranch" => vec![label(&row.operands[1])?, label(&row.operands[2])?],
                "qjumpr" => (0..rows.len()).collect(),
                "fault" | "lift.ret" | "lift.retval" => Vec::new(),
                _ => vec![k + 1],
            });
        }
        let regions = self.region_ranges(f)?;
        let addresses = self.address_constants(f)?;
        let stores_in_closure = |callee: &str| -> Result<bool> { self.closure_may_store(callee) };
        #[derive(Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
        struct State {
            outstanding: BTreeMap<Invocation, u64>,
            constants: BTreeMap<String, u128>,
        }
        let meet = |a: &State, b: &State| State {
            outstanding: a
                .outstanding
                .iter()
                .filter_map(|(k, n)| {
                    let m = (*n).min(b.outstanding.get(k).copied().unwrap_or(0));
                    (m > 0).then(|| (k.clone(), m))
                })
                .collect(),
            constants: a
                .constants
                .iter()
                .filter(|(k, v)| b.constants.get(*k) == Some(v))
                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), *v))
                .collect(),
        };
        let transfer = |row: &Instruction, state: &State| -> Result<State> {
            let mut next = state.clone();
            let op = row.op.as_str();

            // Consume the matched inverse before its delivery invalidates readers.
            // Final validation below checks the pre-row outstanding identity.
            if op == "lift.oracle_uncall" {
                let key = Invocation::from_row(row)?;
                if let Some(n) = next.outstanding.get_mut(&key) {
                    *n -= 1;
                    if *n == 0 {
                        next.outstanding.remove(&key);
                    }
                }
            }
            let delivery = matches!(op, "lift.oracle_call" | "lift.oracle_uncall");
            let mut writes: BTreeSet<String> = row.lhs.iter().cloned().collect();
            if delivery {
                writes.extend([row.operands[3].clone(), row.operands[4].clone()]);
            }
            if op == "lift.perm_call" {
                writes.extend(list(&row.operands[1])?);
            }
            // Cell writes: None = no cell written, Some(None) = unknown address.
            let mut cells: Vec<Option<(u128, u128)>> = Vec::new();
            if let Some(w) = op.strip_prefix("lift.store.i") {
                let n = crate::object::host_count(w, "store width")? as u128 / 8;
                cells.push(state.constants.get(&row.operands[0]).map(|c| (*c, n)));
            }
            if op == "lift.call" && stores_in_closure(row.operands[0].trim_start_matches('@'))? {
                cells.push(None);
            }
            let mut mut_regions = BTreeSet::new();
            if op == "lift.perm_call" {
                let callee = self.declaration(row.operands[0].trim_start_matches('@'))?;
                for (p, n) in callee.params[2].iter().zip(list(&row.operands[3])?) {
                    if p.role.as_deref() == Some("mut") {
                        mut_regions.insert(n);
                    }
                }
            }
            next.outstanding.retain(|k, _| {
                let touches = k.ins.iter().any(|w| writes.contains(w))
                    || (!delivery && [&k.target, &k.fault].iter().any(|w| writes.contains(*w)));
                let clobbers = k.mem.iter().any(|r| {
                    mut_regions.contains(r)
                        || cells.iter().any(|c| match (c, regions.get(r)) {
                            (None, _) | (_, None) => true,
                            (Some((p, n)), Some((base, size))) => {
                                // [p, p+n) meets [base, base+size), computed without wrap.
                                *p < base.saturating_add(*size) && *base < p.saturating_add(*n)
                            }
                        })
                });
                !(touches || clobbers)
            });
            for w in &writes {
                next.constants.remove(w);
            }
            match op {
                "lift.oracle_call" => {
                    *next
                        .outstanding
                        .entry(Invocation::from_row(row)?)
                        .or_default() += 1
                }
                "lift.addr" => {
                    if let Some(base) = addresses.get(row.operands[0].trim_start_matches('@')) {
                        next.constants.insert(row.lhs[0].clone(), *base);
                    }
                }
                _ => {}
            }
            Ok(next)
        };
        let mut entry: Vec<Option<State>> = vec![None; rows.len()];
        entry[0] = Some(State {
            outstanding: BTreeMap::new(),
            constants: BTreeMap::new(),
        });
        let mut work = vec![0usize];
        while let Some(k) = work.pop() {
            let state = entry[k].clone().expect("queued rows have a state");
            let out = transfer(rows[k], &state)?;
            for &s in &successors[k] {
                let merged = match &entry[s] {
                    None => out.clone(),
                    Some(prior) => meet(prior, &out),
                };
                if entry[s].as_ref() != Some(&merged) {
                    entry[s] = Some(merged);
                    work.push(s);
                }
            }
        }
        for (k, row) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
            if row.op != "lift.oracle_uncall" {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(state) = &entry[k] else { continue };
            if !state.outstanding.contains_key(&Invocation::from_row(row)?) {
                return err(
                    "§5.5",
                    format!(
                        "lift.oracle_uncall at line {} has no outstanding matching lift.oracle_call on every path with unchanged ins, tgt, fr and supplied cells",
                        row.line
                    ),
                );
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
    /// Base and size of each mapped interface region of an oracle (§7.2).
    fn region_ranges(&self, f: &Function) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, (u128, u128)>> {
        let mut out = BTreeMap::new();
        if f.kind != "oracle" || f.params[3].is_empty() {
            return Ok(out);
        }
        let Some(layout) = self.section("layout") else {
            return Ok(out);
        };
        let mapping = layout.get("interface_regions")?.get(&f.name)?;
        for p in &f.params[3] {
            let Type::Region(a, _) = p.ty else {
                return err("§5.1", "mem slot requires region type");
            };
            let base = mapping.get(&p.name)?.get("base")?.uint()?;
            let size = crate::oracle::power_of_two(a as u128).unwrap_or(u128::MAX);
            out.insert(p.name.clone(), (base, size));
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
    /// lift.addr results known from the layout: globals and this oracle's regions.
    fn address_constants(&self, f: &Function) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, u128>> {
        let mut out: BTreeMap<String, u128> = self
            .region_ranges(f)?
            .into_iter()
            .map(|(n, (base, _))| (n, base))
            .collect();
        if let Some(layout) = self.section("layout") {
            for (n, g) in layout.get("globals")?.object()? {
                out.insert(n.clone(), g.get("base")?.uint()?);
            }
        }
        Ok(out)
    }
    /// Whether an lproc's transitive closure contains a lift.store.
    fn closure_may_store(&self, root: &str) -> Result<bool> {
        let mut pending = vec![root.to_string()];
        let mut seen = BTreeSet::new();
        while let Some(n) = pending.pop() {
            if !seen.insert(n.clone()) {
                continue;
            }
            let Some(f) = self.functions.get(&n) else {
                return Ok(true); // unresolved import: may store
            };
            for i in f.instructions() {
                if i.op.starts_with("lift.store.") {
                    return Ok(true);
                }
                if i.op == "lift.call" {
                    pending.push(i.operands[0].trim_start_matches('@').into());
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(false)
    }
}

//! Certificate schemas, bindings and references (§9.4, §12).
use crate::{
    err,
    json::Json,
    metadata::{hash, nonnegative, text, variant},
    sha256_hex, Error, Function, Object, Result, Type,
};
use std::collections::{BTreeMap, BTreeSet};

fn contextual<T>(rule: &str, f: impl FnOnce() -> Result<T>) -> Result<T> {
    f().map_err(|e| Error(format!("{rule}: {e}")))
}
fn decimal(value: &Json) -> Result<&str> {
    let s = match value {
        Json::String(s) | Json::Number(s) => s,
        _ => return err("§12", "decimal required"),
    };
    if s.is_empty() {
        return err("§12", "empty decimal");
    }
    nonnegative(&Json::String(s.strip_prefix('-').unwrap_or(s).into()))?;
    Ok(s)
}
fn metric_map(value: &Json) -> Result<()> {
    value.fields(&[], &["operator_norm", "diamond"])?;
    for v in value.object()?.values() {
        nonnegative(v)?;
    }
    Ok(())
}
fn context_key(key: &str) -> Result<(&str, u128)> {
    let (name, controls) = key
        .split_once(':')
        .ok_or_else(|| Error("§12: variant:inherited_controls key required".into()))?;
    variant(&Json::String(name.into()))?;
    let n = crate::object::host_count(controls, "inherited control count")?;
    Ok((name, n as u128))
}
/// The closed §8.1 AST; frame expressions bind only c.
pub(crate) fn expression(value: &Json, variables: &BTreeSet<&str>) -> Result<()> {
    match value {
        Json::Number(_) => {
            decimal(value)?;
        }
        Json::Object(fields) => {
            if fields.contains_key("var") {
                value.fields(&["var"], &[])?;
                if !variables.contains(value.get("var")?.string()?) {
                    return err("§8.1", "expression references an unbound variable");
                }
            } else if fields.contains_key("op") {
                value.fields(&["op", "args"], &[])?;
                let arity = match value.get("op")?.string()? {
                    "+" | "-" | "*" | "/" | "max" | "min" => 2,
                    "ceil" => 1,
                    "log2inv_eps" => 0,
                    _ => return err("§8.1", "unknown expression operator"),
                };
                let args = value.get("args")?.array()?;
                if args.len() != arity {
                    return err("§8.1", "expression arity mismatch");
                }
                if value.get("op")?.string()? == "log2inv_eps" && !variables.contains("eps") {
                    return err("§8.1", "epsilon is unbound");
                }
                for a in args {
                    expression(a, variables)?;
                }
            } else {
                value.fields(&["table", "index"], &[])?;
                text(value.get("table")?)?;
                let index = value.get("index")?.string()?;
                if (index == "k" && !variables.contains("k"))
                    || (index == "eps_decade" && !variables.contains("eps"))
                    || !["k", "eps_decade"].contains(&index)
                {
                    return err("§8.1", "unbound table index");

                "scratch",
                "retained_history",
                "borrow",
                "scheme_ancillae",
            ],
            &["live_ranges"],
        )?;

            slot.fields(&["role", "width", "class"], &["name"])?;
            if !["in", "mut", "tgt", "fault", "control"].contains(&text(slot.get("role")?)?) {
                return err("§9.4", "invalid interface role");
            }
            if slot.get("width")?.uint()? == 0 {
                return err("§9.4", "zero-width frame slot");

            if let Some(name) = slot.object()?.get("name") {
                text(name)?;

        let variables = BTreeSet::from(["c"]);
        expression(value.get("retained_history")?, &variables)?;

                        .object()
                        .is_ok_and(|m| m.contains_key("clean") || m.contains_key("dirty"))

                    count.fields(&["clean", "dirty"], &[])?;
                    expression(count.get("clean")?, &variables)?;
                    expression(count.get("dirty")?, &variables)?;
                } else {
                    expression(count, &variables)?;
                }
            }
        }
        if let Some(ranges) = value.object()?.get("live_ranges") {
            let mut grouped: BTreeMap<String, Vec<(u128, u128)>> = BTreeMap::new();
            for r in ranges.array()? {
                r.fields(&["frame", "start", "end"], &[])?;
                let id = text(r.get("frame")?)?.to_string();
                let lo = r.get("start")?.uint()?;
                let hi = r.get("end")?.uint()?;
                if lo >= hi {
                    return err("§9.4", "empty or inverted shared-frame live range");
                }
                let prior = grouped.entry(id).or_default();
                if prior.iter().any(|(a, b)| lo < *b && *a < hi) {

}
fn domain(value: &Json, f: &Function) -> Result<()> {

        for b in value.get(group)?.array()? {
            b.fields(&["name", "width", "lo", "hi"], &[])?;
            let name = text(b.get("name")?)?;
            if !names.insert(name.to_string()) {
                return err("§12.2", "repeated domain component");
            }
            let width = b.get("width")?.uint()?;
            let bits =
                usize::try_from(width).map_err(|_| Error("host limit: domain width".into()))?;
            if width == 0 {
                return err("§12.2", "zero-width domain component");
            }
            // Bounds are exact integers of any size, within the bundle width.
            let lo = crate::BitVector::parse_unsigned_exact(bits, b.get("lo")?.uint_text()?)
                .map_err(|e| Error(format!("§12.2: domain lo outside bundle width: {e}")))?;
            let hi = crate::BitVector::parse_unsigned_exact(bits, b.get("hi")?.uint_text()?)
                .map_err(|e| Error(format!("§12.2: domain hi outside bundle width: {e}")))?;
            if lo.unsigned_cmp(&hi)? == std::cmp::Ordering::Greater {
                return err("§12.2", "domain interval with lo > hi");
            }
            if group == "bundles" {
                let p = f
                    .params
                    .iter()
                    .flatten()
                    .find(|p| p.name == name && matches!(p.ty, Type::Wire(_)))
                    .ok_or_else(|| Error("§12.2: unknown domain interface bundle".into()))?;
                if p.ty.width(32)? as u128 != width {
                    return err("§12.2", "domain bundle width mismatch");
                }
            }
        }
    }
    for region in value.get("regions")?.array()? {
        region.fields(&["name", "cells"], &[])?;
        let name = text(region.get("name")?)?;
        if !names.insert(name.to_string()) {
            return err("§12.2", "repeated domain region");
        }
        let (a, w) = f
            .params
            .iter()
            .flatten()
            .find_map(|p| {
                if p.name == name {
                    if let Type::Region(a, w) = p.ty {
                        Some((a, w))
                    } else {
                        None
                    }
                } else {
                    None
                }
            })
            .ok_or_else(|| Error("§12.2: unknown domain interface region".into()))?;
        let cells = region.get("cells")?;
        if cells == &Json::String("all".into()) {
            continue;
        }
        let mut indices = BTreeSet::new();
        for cell in cells.array()? {
            cell.fields(&["index", "lo", "hi"], &[])?;
            let index = cell.get("index")?.uint()?;
            let bits = usize::try_from(w).map_err(|_| Error("host limit: cell width".into()))?;
            let lo = crate::BitVector::parse_unsigned_exact(bits, cell.get("lo")?.uint_text()?)?;
            let hi = crate::BitVector::parse_unsigned_exact(bits, cell.get("hi")?.uint_text()?)?;
            if crate::oracle::power_of_two(a as u128).is_some_and(|cells| index >= cells)
                || !indices.insert(index)
                || lo.unsigned_cmp(&hi)? == std::cmp::Ordering::Greater

    }

}
fn index(value: &Json, count: usize) -> Result<usize> {
    let n = usize::try_from(value.uint()?)
        .map_err(|_| Error("§12: claim index exceeds host range".into()))?;
    if n >= count {
        return err("§12", "claim index out of range or cyclic subclaim");
    }
    Ok(n)
}
fn subject(value: &Json) -> Result<()> {
    value.fields(
        &[
            "closure_hash",
            "variant",
            "inherited_controls",
            "schedule_hash",
        ],
        &[],
    )?;
    hash(value.get("closure_hash")?)?;
    hash(value.get("schedule_hash")?)?;
    variant(value.get("variant")?)?;
    value.get("inherited_controls")?.uint()?;
    Ok(())
}

    fn validate_claim(&self, c: &Json, f: &Function, position: usize) -> Result<()> {

            "exhaustive" => {

                domain(c.get("domain")?, f)?;
                let expected = c.get("expected")?;
                if expected == &Json::String("oracle".into()) {
                    subject(c.get("subject")?)?;
                } else {
                    let e = expected.object()?;
                    if e.contains_key("table") {
                        expected.fields(&["table"], &[])?;
                        expected.get("table")?.array()?;
                    } else {
                        expected.fields(&["program"], &[])?;
                        hash(expected.get("program")?)?;
                    }
                }
            }
            "sampled" => {
                c.fields(&["kind", "domain", "sampler"], &["label"])?;
                domain(c.get("domain")?, f)?;
                let sampler = c.get("sampler")?;
                sampler.fields(&["algorithm", "seed", "count"], &[])?;
                if sampler.get("algorithm")?.string()? != "xoshiro256**" {
                    return err("§12.1", "unsupported sampler algorithm");
                }
                let seed = sampler.get("seed")?.array()?;
                if seed.len() != 4 {
                    return err("§12.1", "xoshiro seed must have four words");
                }
                let mut nonzero = false;
                for word in seed {
                    let n = word.string()?.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| {
                        Error("§12.1: seed words must be u64 decimal strings".into())
                    })?;
                    nonzero |= n != 0;
                }
                if !nonzero {
                    return err("§12.1", "all-zero sampler seed");
                }
                sampler.get("count")?.uint()?;
            }
            "structural" => {
                c.fields(&["kind", "rule", "subclaims", "witness"], &["label"])?;
                for claim in c.get("subclaims")?.array()? {
                    index(claim, position)?;
                }
                let witness = c.get("witness")?;
                match c.get("rule")?.string()? {
                    "adjoint_table" => witness.fields(&[], &[])?,
                    "inverse_pair_library" => {
                        witness.fields(&["library_closure_hash", "claim_index"], &[])?;
                        hash(witness.get("library_closure_hash")?)?;
                        witness.get("claim_index")?.uint()?;
                    }
                    "translation_lemma" => {
                        witness.fields(&["V", "W", "X", "B", "frame"], &[])?;
                        for group in ["V", "W", "frame"] {
                            for point in witness.get(group)?.array()? {
                                let p = point.array()?;
                                if p.len() != 3 {
                                    return err(
                                        "§12",
                                        "structural point must be a program-point tuple",
                                    );
                                }
                                hash(&p[0])?;
                                text(&p[1])?;
                                p[2].uint()?;
                            }
                        }
                        for group in ["X", "B"] {
                            for wire in witness.get(group)?.array()? {
                                text(wire)?;
                            }
                        }
                        if witness.get("frame")?.array()?.len() != 2 {
                            return err("§12", "frame needs first and last points");
                        }
                    }
                    _ => return err("§12", "unknown structural rule"),
                }
            }
            "numerical" | "channel" => {
                let channel = c.get("kind")?.string()? == "channel";
                let required = if channel {
                    vec![
                        "kind",
                        "subject",
                        "metric",
                        "precision_bits",
                        "bound",
                        "dual",
                    ]
                } else {
                    vec!["kind", "subject", "metric", "precision_bits", "bound"]
                };
                c.fields(&required, &["label"])?;
                subject(c.get("subject")?)?;
                if c.get("metric")?.string()? != if channel { "diamond" } else { "operator_norm" } {
                    return err("§12.1", "claim kind and metric mismatch");
                }
                if c.get("precision_bits")?.uint()? == 0 {
                    return err("§12.1", "precision must be positive");
                }
                nonnegative(c.get("bound")?)?;
                if channel {
                    for witness in c.get("dual")?.array()? {
                        witness.fields(&["Y", "mu"], &[])?;
                        nonnegative(witness.get("mu")?)?;
                        for entry in witness.get("Y")?.array()? {
                            let entry = entry.array()?;
                            if entry.len() != 4 {
                                return err(
                                    "§12.1",
                                    "interval complex entry requires four endpoints",
                                );
                            }
                            for endpoint in entry {
                                decimal(endpoint)?;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            _ => return err("§12.1", "unknown certificate claim kind"),
        }
        if let Some(label) = c.object()?.get("label") {
            if !["proof", "evidence"].contains(&label.string()?) {
                return err("§12", "unknown claim label");
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }
}
